description: Autorisations de voiries délivrées par le Département de l'Indre is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Département de l'Indre. Publication in electronic format of the list of road permits issued by the Department of Indre. Coverage: Département de l'Indre. The portal shows the English title as "Road authorisations issued by the Department of Indre" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Département de l'Indre. Its keywords include voirie, travaux-publics, autorisation-voie-departementale, permis-construction, autorisation-administrative. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ODS. The listing shows 2026-02-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
